Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"file_version\":{\"name\":\"my.pdf\",\"notes\":\"This file version is good\",\"upload_uuid\":\"1QJ83Q56CVQR4X3C0JG7YV86F8\"}}"

headers = {
    'Authorization': "Bearer REPLACE_BEARER_TOKEN",
    'content-type': "application/json"
    }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/file_versions?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&file_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
